items.title: Alphonse Picou Interview, 1958-04-04
items.q: Louis Nelson. Oh yeah, yeah. That's one of my first ones.

ctx.x: No, no, no, no, no, no, no. In the French opera, did they have a pretty good, a large orchestra, about 50 pieces? Oh, about that. A big orchestra. Big orchestra. Did you ever study with any of the musicians, take lessons from any of those musicians? No, they had me in the band, rolling my clarinet, all night. In the French opera? At the French opera. You did? Oh, they had me, oh me? Oh no. I've been all through that. You see this? I can take that instrument, I can go in the jazz band, I can go in any band, I can…
Yeah, wonderful. Did you ever have, did you ever take any pupils yourself to do that?
Oh no. See the Beche's one. Uh huh. What you call them? We took our pictures. George Oliver. No. Louis Nelson. Oh yeah, yeah. That's one of my first ones.
